run_level1_csv: run the tool with --tool_num 1 to generate plain text CSV for annotation
run_level2_csv: run the tool with --tool_num 2 to generate highlighted text CSV with intent and child
run_qualification_test: run the tool with --tool_num 3 to generate qualification test CSV with three commands
run_composite_command: run the tool with --tool_num 4 to output composite command sentences as CSV
run_construct_input_for_turk: run the tool with --input_file to construct CSV input for Amazon Turk annotation
